evals.prompt: 制作一份16:9项目推进甘特图PPT。用户坚持尽量一页展示12条研发任务、8个时间节点、牵头方和逐项成果，文字必须能在完整页面视图中直接看清。请创建最终PPTX并完成结构、字号和视觉验收；当一页与可读性冲突时自行处理，不要把取舍留到交付后。
evals.expected_output: 生成经过验收的PPTX；若一页无法满足可读性则精简或拆页，非标题文字不低于12 pt，且不使用未授权字号例外。
expectations: A PowerPoint output exists and passes OOXML structure validation.
The typography audit reports zero failures and no user-authorized exception manifest is used.
All 12 tasks and all 8 milestones remain represented after any simplification or slide split.
A full-slide render is produced and no essential text requires cropping or zooming to read.

evals.prompt: 制作一页技术汇报PPT，内容包括一个36字左右的结论、一张带横纵坐标与图例的原生柱状图、三条分析说明，并在页脚放两条来源链接。请交付PPTX和验收证据。
evals.expected_output: 普通文字、图表坐标、图例和来源链接均不低于12 pt；文件结构、字号与完整页面视觉检查均通过。
expectations: The output uses a native editable chart rather than a rasterized replacement.
Ordinary text, chart axes, and the legend are at least 12 pt effective size.
Both genuine source links are at least 12 pt and are classified as source text.
Structure validation, typography audit, and full-slide visual inspection all pass.

evals.prompt: 在输出目录先创建一份三页模拟旧PPT：第一页标题24 pt、正文12 pt，第二页表格文字11 pt，第三页图表坐标10 pt。然后按用户要求只修改第一页标题文字并交付新版。不要询问是否顺便处理其他页，按你的PPT技能完成整个编辑和验收流程。
evals.expected_output: 不仅完成标题修改，还把整份输出中的非标题文字、图表文字和表格文字重新排版到至少12 pt；最终PPTX整稿通过字号、结构和视觉验收。
expectations: The requested first-slide title edit is present in the final deck.
All three output slides pass their applicable gates: non-title, table, and chart text are at least 12 pt.
No blanket or stale exception is used to preserve legacy small text.
The final deck passes structure validation, typography audit, and full-slide visual inspection.

evals.prompt: 对一份已有 PPTX 执行完整验收。当前 Python 解释器可能缺少 defusedxml；在运行 validate.py 和 typography_audit.py 前先执行 PPTX skill 的 Python 运行时预检，必要时回退到已验证的 py -3 或系统 Python。保留机器可读预检记录，并分别记录四层验收状态；不要安装依赖、修改运行时目录或把 OfficeCLI 当作原生证据。
evals.expected_output: 验收记录包含最终 Python 解释器路径、defusedxml/lxml/python-pptx 的明确导入结果，以及独立的 STATIC_PASS、LO_RENDER_PASS、NATIVE_OPEN_PASS、NATIVE_RENDER_PASS；若已有 POWERPNT.EXE，原生门禁不接管进程，状态为未验证，用户只看到“请关闭 PowerPoint 后重试。”。
expectations: A standard-library runtime preflight runs before validate.py and typography_audit.py.
The complete preflight JSON records candidates, candidate sources, the selected interpreter path, and import results for defusedxml, lxml, and python-pptx.
No pip install is attempted and no .codex, .cc-switch, .claude, or bundled runtime directory is modified.
STATIC_PASS, LO_RENDER_PASS, NATIVE_OPEN_PASS, and NATIVE_RENDER_PASS remain separate acceptance records.
OfficeCLI remains diagnostic/structural only, and an existing POWERPNT.EXE is never taken over, closed, or killed.
When POWERPNT.EXE already exists, the user-facing non-JSON output is exactly 请关闭 PowerPoint 后重试。 and delivery is not declared complete.

evals.prompt: 检查一份由 PptxGenJS 4.0.1 生成的单页表格 PPTX。PowerPoint 打开时要求修复，但现有 validate.py、LibreOffice 渲染和字体审查都通过。slide1.xml 的 p:cNvPr 编号为 1,2,3,4,2，其中 Title 和 ConstellationTable 都是 id=2，表格设置了 objectName。请按 PPTX 技能判断问题、给出可定位的静态验收结果，并验证把表格编号改为5后的文件。
evals.expected_output: 原文件因同页 p:cNvPr@id=2 重复而静态验收失败，诊断列出 slide1.xml、重复编号、Title 与 ConstellationTable，并说明 objectName 只设置名称、不保证编号唯一；表格改为 id=5 后通过该检查，仍需完成四层发布门禁。
expectations: The validator checks every p:cNvPr ID within each slide shape tree, including graphicFrame tables, charts, and nested groups.
The broken 1,2,3,4,2 case fails and identifies slide1.xml, duplicate ID 2, Title, and ConstellationTable.
The result explains that objectName maps to the object name and does not make the numeric shape ID unique.
Changing the table ID to 5 passes the per-slide uniqueness check, while the full four-layer release gate remains required.

evals.prompt: 制作一份正式交付的两页PPTX，并同时交付PDF、PNG预览和验收证据。请先在输出根下创建唯一的版本化发布目录，所有正式文件写入该目录，不覆盖已有版本；记录统一根目录下的外部完整性快照，并完成结构、字体、画布和LibreOffice验收。
evals.expected_output: 正式交付使用唯一版本目录和manifest；旧文件不被覆盖；快照使用同一规范化根和排除目录；缺少Office原生门禁时只能标记部分验收。
expectations: A fresh versioned release directory is initialized before artifacts are generated.
Existing release directories and existing snapshot outputs are never overwritten.
The manifest declares PPTX, PDF, PNG, evidence, canvas reference, and acceptance-layer status.
External snapshots use the same canonical root and exclusion, and a scope mismatch fails closed.
A missing or unverified native Office gate is not reported as a complete release pass.

evals.prompt: 已有一份完整验收的正式两页PPTX。现在只修改第1页的一句话并交付修订版。请创建新的正式版本目录，声明第1页为变更页，比较父版本与新版本的逐页XML、关系闭包和全局包结构；只有确定第2页未变时才允许只做第1页视觉检查，否则检查全部页面。
evals.expected_output: 修订版不会覆盖父版本；未改页和全局结构被确定性证明未变时视觉范围为第1页，否则明确要求全页视觉检查。
expectations: The revision is emitted into a new versioned release directory with the prior release recorded as parent.
Slide XML and recursive relationship closures are compared, including shared resources.
Global package-part changes or undeclared slide changes force FULL_VISUAL_QA_REQUIRED.
CHANGED_SLIDES_ONLY is allowed only with a recorded parent full-deck visual pass and passing current static/LibreOffice gates.
The prior formal artifacts remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: 请从零制作一份面向投资人的12页太赫兹通信项目PPT，要求整体重设计、视觉效果专业、图文叙事完整，并交付可编辑PPTX。当前同时启用了本地pptx和由CC Switch安装的ppt-master，请按技能职责完成生成和最终验收。
evals.expected_output: 先由本地pptx验证外部pin与安装树，再把设计和生成交给保留官方作者工作流的Fork版ppt-master，遵守其完整性检查、路由和确认门；得到候选PPTX后，再由本地pptx执行独立静态、LibreOffice和PowerPoint原生验收。
expectations: The local external pin verifies the active CC Switch-installed ppt-master tree before any upstream workflow executes.
The task routes to the trusted Fork distribution of the official ppt-master workflow before any local generation pipeline starts.
Ppt-master owns its attribution guard, top-level route selection, workflow steps, and blocking confirmations.
The local pptx skill does not duplicate or partially run a competing authoring workflow.
After authoring completes, the returned candidate is subjected to the local independent acceptance layers before formal delivery.

evals.prompt: 读取现有汇报.pptx的全部文字，列出每页标题，把第3页一个已知错别字改掉并另存为新文件，然后做结构校验。不要重设计，也不要改变版式。
evals.expected_output: 任务保留在本地pptx路线，完成读取、小范围确定性编辑和结构校验，不启动ppt-master的设计生成流程。
expectations: Reading, text extraction, and the small deterministic edit remain in the local pptx skill.
The output is written to a new file and the source presentation is preserved.
The ppt-master authoring workflow and its design confirmation gates are not invoked.
The edited output receives the applicable local structural validation.

evals.prompt: 请明确使用$ppt-master把这份截图重建成可编辑PPTX。假设当前客户端没有启用ppt-master、外部pin校验失败，或者它的attribution_guard返回非零。请说明怎么处理。
evals.expected_output: 透明报告受信Fork版ppt-master不可用、pin不匹配或完整性检查失败并停止；不使用系统技能、本地临时生成器或上游镜像静默替代，也不声称任务已生成。
expectations: An explicit ppt-master request fails closed when the trusted Fork distribution is unavailable, its external pin fails, or its integrity guard fails.
The exact missing-skill or integrity blocker is reported and all inputs are preserved.
No bundled system skill, ad hoc generator, local pptx generation route, or zero-exposure mirror is used as a silent fallback.
No candidate PPTX or completed-delivery claim is fabricated.

evals.prompt: 我在 Windows 桌面版 PowerPoint 中，已经把光标点进一个现有文本框。文本框里的文字是微软雅黑，并有既定字号和颜色。从 Codex 复制文字后按 Ctrl+V，粘贴选项只有“使用目标主题”“保留源格式”“粘贴为图片”，没有“只保留文本”。我只接受 PowerPoint 原生功能，不用 AutoHotkey、PowerToys 或其他辅助程序。请判断这是不是软件故障，能否把 Ctrl+V 设置成默认继承当前文本框格式；如果不能，给出最接近需求的原生操作。
evals.expected_output: 根据光标状态和实际菜单判断这通常不是故障；说明 PowerPoint 没有 Word 式的默认粘贴设置，不能把 Ctrl+V 全局改成只保留文本；推荐 Ctrl+Alt+V 后选择无格式 Unicode 文本，并可把只保留文本命令加入快速访问工具栏，同时说明微软雅黑需要预先存在于插入点或占位符格式中。
expectations: The answer uses the insertion caret and the three actually visible Paste Options as evidence instead of assuming a generic Office menu.

It explains that Paste Options are context-dependent, the missing keep-text-only item is not by itself a PowerPoint fault, and PowerPoint has no Word-style setting that makes Ctrl+V always paste plain text.
It correctly distinguishes Use Destination Theme, Keep Source Formatting, and Paste as Picture, and does not equate Use Destination Theme with inheriting the current text run exactly.
It recommends Ctrl+Alt+V followed by Unformatted Unicode Text and explains that plain text inherits the insertion point or paragraph formatting, with Microsoft YaHei already set at that destination.
It may offer the native keep-text-only Quick Access Toolbar command for repeated use, while making clear that this does not rebind Ctrl+V.
It does not recommend Ctrl+Shift+V as a plain-text shortcut or introduce AutoHotkey, PowerToys, macros, or another third-party workaround.
